# SHEL — Shell (IDEATION 2026-11-13, hygiene re-stamp)

**WATCH → DISCARD.** Carded 2026-11-06 as #11 GLOBAL MOMENTUM at $100.12, −7.9% off its high, with the entry explicitly conditional on establishing a valuation anchor ("ADVANCE only on a target, not on a further rally"). Seven sessions later there is still no SHEL dossier and no anchor, and **SHEL is no longer on the screen at all** (today's GLOBAL list is SAP LLY ABBV MA MRK V CRM AMD MSFT JNJ KO BRK-B).

MOMENTUM_CONTINUATION rule 1: momentum is the entry signal, never the thesis. With the signal gone and no fundamental reason or target on file, the card has nothing left to carry it into Saturday's triage — keeping it as WATCH would spend WEEKLY_DEEP's second-priority slots on a name with neither signal nor anchor.

**Re-test:** re-card only if SHEL re-enters a sleeve **and** a dossier/anchor path exists. The macro backdrop that motivated it has also weakened — Brent 97.76 sits at the deck's FY2026E and the thermal-coal/oil tilts are NEUTRAL, not FAVOR.
